breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 睡梦与突发危象的实时监测预警
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。

breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 对急性心梗、脑梗死、脓毒性休克、急性肝衰竭与热射病而言，哪怕送到急诊室，微血管再灌注损伤、细胞因子风暴和不可逆线粒体坏死仍会在短时间内夺走生命。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 急性多器官微循环级联动力学建模、急诊快速炎症/凝血表型分型、老药新用紧急器官保护筛选。

master.definition_en: A sex cord-stromal tumor occurring in the testis and rarely in the ovary. It is predominantly or completely composed of Leydig cells which may contain crystals of Reinke. In males it usually presents as a painless testicular enlargement and it may be associated with gynecomastia and decreased libido. The majority of the cases have a benign clinical course. Approximately 10% of the cases have a malignant clinical course and metastasize. In females it may be associated with androgenic manifestations and it follows a benign clinical course.

breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 需要发展连续无创可穿戴微循环/血氧/心电多模态传感器、血液微凝血活性快速试纸，结合 AI 在异常触发前几小时识别微血栓与高危信号并立即叫醒预警。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

curated.lethality_detail_zh: 15q11-q13母源UBE3A基因缺失或突变所致（父源拷贝在脑内天然被UBE3A-AS沉默），表现为重度发育迟缓、无语言、共济失调步态、频繁大笑与顽固性癫痫；总体预期寿命接近正常人，但需防范难治性癫痫持续状态及水边溺水意外（患儿常对水有强烈迷恋）。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 目前尚无获批的病因治疗药物，但临床管理聚焦于精准控制癫痫（左乙拉西坦、氯巴占、生酮饮食）、改善严重睡眠障碍以及利用辅助沟通工具（AAC）建立非言语交流，多数患儿情绪愉悦且随年龄增长癫痫有所减轻。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 癫痫持续状态与防溺水处置：1) 发生非惊厥性或惊厥性癫痫持续状态（可表现为突然发呆、反复肌阵挛或全身抽搐>5分钟），立即侧卧清理口腔分泌物并拨打120给予急救镇静药；2) 居家及外出必须对泳池、浴缸、河湖设置物理隔离护栏，严防患儿因迷恋玩水发生溺水。

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) 靶向唤醒脑内沉默的父源UBE3A基因（反义寡核苷酸ASO阻断UBE3A-AS）是全球最受瞩目的病因疗法方向：Ultragenyx/Ionis开发的GTX-102（Apazunersen）在1/2期曾显现改善，但2026年公布的3期Aspire试验未能达到Bayley-4认知主要终点；Roche的Rugonersen亦因疗效有限停止推进；2) Ionis新一代ASO（ION582）及AAV基因替代疗法正继续优化给药方案与评估终点。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 尽管父源唤醒机制极具科学魅力，现有ASO在3期大样本试验中尚未证明明确认知获益，亟需更敏感的生物标志物与早期婴儿干预窗口；2) 顽固性癫痫与重度睡眠剥夺给家长带来巨大照护疲惫；3) 基层对非缺失型（UBE3A突变/单亲二倍体）缺乏甲基化与基因测序联合诊断能力。

master.definition_en: Palmoplantar keratoderma-deafness syndrome is a keratinization disorder characterized by focal or diffuse palmoplantar keratoderma. A patchy distribution is observed with accentuation on the thenars, hypothenars and the arches of the feet. The disease becomes apparent in infancy and is associated with sensorineural hearing loss that shows a variable age of onset. Due to genetic and clinical similarities, it has been proposed that palmoplantar keratoderma-deafness syndrome, knuckle pads-leukonychia-sensorineural deafness-palmoplantar hyperkeratosis syndrome and keratoderma hereditarium mutilans may represent variants of one broad disorder of syndromic deafness with heterogeneous phenotype. The disease is transmitted in an autosomal dominant manner with incomplete penetrance.
synonyms_en: focal palmoplantar keratoderma with sensorineural deafness (subtype)
mondo_categories: disease of genetic or genomic mechanism

master.definition_en: Pigment-dispersion syndrome is an eye disorder that occurs when pigment granules that normally adhere to the back of the iris (the colored part of the eye) flake off into the clear fluid produced by the eye (aqueous humor). These pigment granules may flow towards the drainage canals of the eye, slowly clogging them and raising the pressure within the eye (intraocular pressure or IOP). This rise in eye pressure can cause damage to the optic nerve (the nerve in the back of the eye that carries visual images to the brain). If the optic nerve becomes damaged, pigment-dispersion syndrome becomes pigmentary glaucoma. This happens in about 30% of cases. Pigment-dispersion syndrome commonly presents between the second and fourth decades, which is earlier than other types of glaucoma. While men and women are affected in equal numbers, men develop pigmentary glaucoma up to 3 times more often than women. Myopia (nearsightedness) appears to be an important risk factor in the development of pigment-dispersion syndrome and is present in up to 80% of affected individuals. The condition may be sporadic or follow an autosomal dominant pattern of inheritance with reduced penetrance. At least one gene locus on chromosome 7 has been identified. Pigment-dispersion syndrome can be treated with eye drops or other medications. In some cases, laser surgery may be performed.

master.definition_en: Satoyoshi syndrome is a rare syndrome characterized by progressive, painful, intermittent muscle spasms. These muscle spasms usually start between 6-15 years old. Other symptoms of the syndrome may include diarrhea and an inability of the digestive tract to absorb certain foods, especially carbohydrates (malabsorption). People affected by Satoyoshi syndrome may also have loss of hair on the head and body (alopecia universalis), short stature, and skeletal abnormalities. Women with Satoyoshi syndrome may not have a menstrual cycle (amenorrhea). In all published cases, only one person in a family has Satoyoshi syndrome. This is even true when the person with Satoyoshi syndrome comes from a large family. Satoyoshi syndrome seems to be more common in Japan. The exact cause of the syndrome is unknown, but some researchers think it may be an autoimmune disease. Satoyoshi syndrome can be diagnosed when a doctor sees symptoms that are consistent with the syndrome. The diagnosis can be confirmed by a variety of laboratory tests. Treatment for Satoyoshi syndrome includes medication to suppress the immune system.

master.name_en: encephalopathy, progressive, early-onset, with brain edema and/or leukoencephalopathy, 1
master.definition_en: A rare neurometabolic disease characterized by infantile onset of rapidly progressive neurological deterioration, typically precipitated by a febrile illness. Patients present with hypotonia, loss of previously acquired motor milestones and cognitive skills, ataxia, nystagmus, tremor, seizures, tetraparesis, and respiratory failure, eventually resulting in a vegetative state. Imaging of the brain and spinal cord may show white matter abnormalities, cerebral atrophy, cerebellar edema, and spinal myelopathy. Subacute development of extensive bullous skin lesions within weeks of onset of neurological symptoms has also been reported.

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 睡梦与突发危象的实时监测预警
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 需要发展连续无创可穿戴微循环/血氧/心电多模态传感器、血液微凝血活性快速试纸，结合 AI 在异常触发前几小时识别微血栓与高危信号并立即叫醒预警。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 对急性心梗、脑梗死、脓毒性休克、急性肝衰竭与热射病而言，哪怕送到急诊室，微血管再灌注损伤、细胞因子风暴和不可逆线粒体坏死仍会在短时间内夺走生命。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 急性多器官微循环级联动力学建模、急诊快速炎症/凝血表型分型、老药新用紧急器官保护筛选。

master.definition_en: A very serious type of heart attack during which one of the heart’s major arteries (one of the arteries that supplies oxygen and nutrient-rich blood to the heart muscle) is blocked. ST-segment elevation is an abnormality detected on the 12-lead ECG.

master.name_en: nodal T-follicular helper cell lymphoma, follicular type
master.definition_en: A rare T-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma characterized by generalized lymphadenopathy and predominantly follicular or perifollicular growth pattern, consistent with the expression of T-follicular helper markers. Affected individuals distinctly lack histologic features (such as proliferation of high endothelial venules and expanded follicular dendritic meshworks) typically associated to angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma. It affects elderly individuals (mostly at the sixth decade of life) that present with advanced-stage disease. Majority of the cases have disseminated nodal involvement, whereas involvement of extranodal sites including skin, liver, spleen and bone marrow are also reported. Patients may therefore develop skin rash and immune manifestations.
synonyms_en: Follicular helper T-cell lymphoma, follicular type
Nodal T-cell lymphoma with TFH phenotype
mondo_categories: mature T-cell and NK-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma
